content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

What are the most expensive areas (towns) by average price paid, over the entire available time period? Show the top 20 areas ranked by average sale price descending.

content.statement:
SELECT *
FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
    ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID_SEMANTIC
    METRICS average_price, median_price, sales_count
    DIMENSIONS uk_price_paid.district
)
ORDER BY average_price DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20
